analysis.reason: The source requires a uniform positive constant c independent of A and N. The formalization existentially quantifies c after A, N and their hypotheses, allowing it to depend on the particular input and weakening the uniform asymptotic bound.
analysis.decision_source: Explicit user instruction in this conversation, 2026-11-16 (translated from Chinese): Okay, mark it misaligned; confirms the preceding identical-input and quantifier-order explanation for apap:int-uniform-before.
analysis.review_scope: The exponent-1/12 bound in the main paragraph of the currently frozen README, interpreted as requiring one uniform c>0 for all A and N. Only this int-uniform-before input.

quantifier_comparison.source: exists c > 0, forall N A, P(A,N) -> |A| <= N / exp(c * (log N)^(1/12))
quantifier_comparison.formal: forall N A, P(A,N) -> exists c > 0, |A| <= N / exp(c * (log N)^(1/12))
quantifier_comparison.formal_binders: A and N are implicit universal parameters; hAN and hA precede the existential c.

semantic_argument: Choose c=log(N/m)/(2L)>0. Then exp(cL)=sqrt(N/m), so N/exp(cL)=sqrt(Nm)>m.
Thus every nonempty proper subset admits a local choice of c satisfying the numerical conclusion, without ThreeAPFree; this c may vary with N and A.
The source requires the same positive c for all admissible inputs; the formalization does not express this uniformity.
analysis.endpoint_convention: Adding 1 to each element of range N gives a subset of {1,...,N}, preserving cardinality and the nontrivial three-term arithmetic-progression property; this endpoint difference is not used to support the negative label.

separate_source_issue.argument: A two-element set contains no nontrivial three-term arithmetic progression. Since log 2>0, for every c>0 we have 2/exp(c*(log 2)^(1/12))<2, so both current literal statements fail on this input.
separate_source_issue.needed_source_clarification: The source needs an appropriate small-N qualification, such as sufficiently large N or an effective multiplicative constant; this review did not modify the input.
separate_source_issue.relation_to_label: The negative label records the mismatch in the quantification of a uniform constant; the example on which both statements fail is not presented as a counterexample separating their truth values.

verification.method: Source statement and binder comparison, with symbolic real-arithmetic argument.

limitations: The frozen source uses lowercase log n and contains an extra parenthesis. Its display and mathematical interpretation follow the context as log N; the source file is retained as written.
